program_provided.funding_purpose: Replacing the training-pitch floodlights and keeping under-16 subs at £15 a month.
program_provided.label: Program-provided
program_provided.summary: Quillmere Athletic is a community-owned club on the Wendle estuary. We run a men's first team and reserves in the Wendle & District Senior League, an under-21 development side, and under-18 and under-16 boys' squads. Most of our first team came through our own youth sides or walked in off an open trial night. We film our home games, share honest feedback with players, and we would rather lose a good player to a higher level than hold him back.

updates.body: We are two or three players short of the squad we want going into winter. If you are 18 or over and think you can play at this level, apply through Academy Watch. We watch everyone properly and everyone gets an answer.
updates.title: Open trial nights are back for the first team

updates.body: The first two new columns went in on Saturday thanks to forty volunteers, one borrowed cherry-picker and a lot of bacon rolls. Tuesday and Thursday training stays on the main pitch until the other two are wired. Thank you to everyone who turned out.
updates.title: Training-pitch floodlights: two columns up, two to go
